speaker: Patient
text: 66-year-old white male. The patient reports a 10-day history of fatigue and bilateral lower leg swelling. He mentions a weight loss of 3.6 kg (8 lbs) over the past 6 months without trying. He has a history of chronic bronchitis and uses an albuterol inhaler as needed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Nephrotic Syndrome (likely Membranous Nephropathy or Minimal Change Disease given age and presentation). The combination of significant edema, weight loss, fatigue, and lack of urinary symptoms like dysuria or hematuria points towards a glomerular pathology rather than a UTI. I await the results of the Urinalysis (looking for heavy proteinuria) and the CBC/Liver function tests to confirm.
